teaser: Six in the morning, before anyone else is up, and you are standing in the kitchen moving the same chair back to where it belongs. Life path 4 is the builder, steady and patient with the slow stacking of days, and ISFP is the sort who feels first and explains later, drawn to what looks right before it can say why. Crossed, the two make an odd kind of patience: a person who keeps rebuilding the same shelf until it holds weight and looks like something, who will not call it finished until it also feels true. The order matters here, but so does the color of the paint.
